ai_agents_tab_view.governance_note: Human approval stays strictly in the loop. No autonomous investment or capital allocation decisions.

questions.q: How is our financial data kept private?
questions.a: Hosting, access controls, retention and provider terms must be agreed before any confidential data is shared. Do not claim tenant isolation or no-training guarantees without a verified implementation agreement.

questions.q: Does this replace human financial analysts?
questions.a: No. Our agents prepare first-pass drafts and highlight anomalies; human sign-off is mandatory.

questions.q: Can these agents integrate with Excel and existing ERPs?
questions.a: File formats, connectors, permissions and feasibility are assessed during scoping. No connector is assumed to be included.
